name: @drako/socialcors
description: App Next.js/OpenNext propia de SocialCors (P3). Etapa alias: usa node_modules y src/ de la raíz del monorepo.

scripts.build: next build && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const dirs=["./.next/server", "./.next/standalone/.next/server"]; dirs.forEach(d => { fs.mkdirSync(d, {recursive: true}); ["pages-manifest.json", "app-path-routes-manifest.json", "middleware-manifest.json"].forEach(f => { const p = d + "/" + f; if (!fs.existsSync(p) || fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8").trim() === "") fs.writeFileSync(p, "{}"); }); }); const src="./.next/required-server-files.json"; dirs.forEach(d => { const dest=d.replace("/server", "/required-server-files.json"); if(fs.existsSync(src)&&!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.copyFileSync(src,dest); else if(!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.writeFileSync(dest, JSON.stringify({config:{}})); });' && opennextjs-cloudflare build
